The '''Mining Survey Ship''' was a model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Merrick and Kalb Industries]]. The ''[[Bright Seeker]]'', a vessel operated by [[House Calipsa]], was a modified Mining Survey Ship.<ref name="LD" />
